description: Le périmètre du marché couvre les activités relatives à la conduite et au maintien en conditions opérationnelles en vue d’assurer la disponibilité et la sécurité des installations de courant fort, de courant faible, de courant faible de sécurité et des équipements électromécaniques des centres CEA DAM. title: Debris Boom Supply and Install at Harry S. Truman Lake Project
description: Contractor Questions/Government Answers are posted. The purpose of the debris boom is to prevent floating debris from impacting the dam's tainter gates, which is crucial for maintaining the full operational capacity of the spillway. The boom will also serve as a visual barrier to boaters. The Contractor shall provide all labor, materials, equipment, engineering, fabrication, delivery, and optional installation necessary to furnish a complete debris boom system at Harry S. Truman Dam. The approximately 2,000-foot boom shall be designed to intercept floating debris upstream of the spillway and withstand site-specific hydraulic, wind, wave, debris, and impact loading conditions. The debris boom shall be designed for an 800-foot-long by 3-foot-thick debris field, use a minimum safety factor of 2.0 for design loads, withstand a direct head-on impact from an 18-inch-diameter, 100-foot-long log traveling at the maximum design water velocity, and withstand design conditions including 50 mph wind speed and 5-foot wave height. This acquisition is not set-aside for small business concerns and is competed as full and open competition, Unrestricted. An organized site visit has been scheduled for: Friday, 9 October 2026 at 11am.

title: Employee Transit Benefits Program
description: The Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA) intends to award a sole source purchase order as authorized by Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Overhaul (RFO) 12.102(b), for the commercial acquisition of access to the Washington Metro Area Transit Authority (WMATA) SmartBenefits Commuter Benefits system to enroll, withdraw, and change employee transit benefits. title: JROTC JLAB
description: The U.S. Government desires to procure non-personal services contract to provide for the planning, coordination, and execution of the Junior Reserve Officers Training Corps (JROTC) Leadership and Academic Bowls (JLAB) for the United States Army Cadet Command (USACC) which support Army JROTC units around the country and overseas. The services may be performed from any location in the United States, however the national championships shall be held in the Washington, D.C. area. Components and elements of service support include registration, developing questions, hosting web sites, making travel arrangements, securing lodging, meals and other logistics required in support of JROTC operations for competitions leading up to the national championship. Performance requirements which must be met are listed in the Performance Work Statement (PWS).

title: Debris Boom Supply and Install at Harry S. Truman Lake Project
description: The purpose of the debris boom is to prevent floating debris from impacting the dam's tainter gates, which is crucial for maintaining the full operational capacity of the spillway. The boom will also serve as a visual barrier to boaters. The Contractor shall provide all labor, materials, equipment, engineering, fabrication, delivery, and optional installation necessary to furnish a complete debris boom system at Harry S. Truman Dam. The approximately 2,000-foot boom shall be designed to intercept floating debris upstream of the spillway and withstand site-specific hydraulic, wind, wave, debris, and impact loading conditions. The debris boom shall be designed for an 800-foot-long by 3-foot-thick debris field, use a minimum safety factor of 2.0 for design loads, withstand a direct head-on impact from an 18-inch-diameter, 100-foot-long log traveling at the maximum design water velocity, and withstand design conditions including 50 mph wind speed and 5-foot wave height. This acquisition is not set-aside for small business concerns and is competed as full and open competition, Unrestricted. An organized site visit has been scheduled for: Friday, 9 October 2026 at 11am.

title: Valstybinių parkų lankytojų centrų vidaus ekspozicijų projektavimo ir įrengimo (atnaujinimo) paslaugos
description: Įgyvendinant projektą Nr. 01-027-P-0005 „Saugomų teritorijų planavimas ir tvarkymas, ekosistemų, buveinių ir rūšių geros būklės palaikymas visoje Lietuvos teritorijoje“, numatoma įsigyti valstybinių parkų lankytojų centrų vidaus ekspozicijų projektavimo ir įrengimo (atnaujinimo) paslaugas. Konsultacijoje nagrinėjamas Neries regioninio parko, Žemaitijos nacionalinio parko ir Tytuvėnų regioninio parko lankytojų centrų ekspozicijų pirkimo modelis. Numatoma skaidyti pirkimą pagal atskirus valstybinių parkų, kuriuose bus atnaujinamos, papildomos ekspozicijos, lankytojų centrus. Pirkimu siekiamas tikslas: sukurti ir įrengti vieningą, funkciškai veikiančią, informatyvią ir paveikią ekspoziciją. Kiekvienos dalies apimtis: ekspozicijos idėjos ir projekto parengimas, suderinimas, elementų gamyba, techninės įrangos tiekimas ir montavimas, programavimas, integravimas, bandymai ir darbuotojų mokymas. Galutinė įrangos sudėtis, kiekiai ir parametrai priklausys nuo suderintų projektinių sprendinių. Konsultacijos tikslas – įvertinti papildomą skaidymą pagal veiklas, konkurenciją, integravimo rizikų valdymą ir tinkamą kainodarą. Galutiniai sprendimai dėl pirkimo struktūros ir kainodaros dar nepriimti. Prie šios rinkos konsultacijos pateikiama tik viena Neries regioninio parko lankytojų centrų ekspozicijų pirkimo užduotis.

description: Le présent avis vise à mettre en place un marché mono-titulaire, non alloti, à minimum et maximum exprimés en quantités, exécuté par ordres de livraison et de service, ayant pour objet, pour chaque site équipé : la conception, la fourniture, l'installation et la mise en service d'un dispositif de mesure au défilé du profil des roues de tramway (capteurs laser, caméras, éclairage, armoire, modules de traitement et de communication) ; la fourniture, le paramétrage et la mise en service du logiciel de reconstruction et d'exploitation des profils de roues et son intégration au système d'information de maintenance de la RATP ; l'étude d'implantation et les prestations d'intégration sur l'infrastructure ; les essais, la validation métrologique et l'accompagnement d'une période probatoire de six mois ; la documentation en français et la formation des mainteneurs ; la garantie de trois ans à compter de la réception définitive, incluant la maintenance du dispositif et du logiciel ; la fourniture de pièces de rechange et la gestion de l'obsolescence (disponibilité garantie quinze ans) ; sur commande, la maintenance post-garantie. Minimum (engagement ferme) : équipement de la ligne T2, soit deux (2) dispositifs en voie de remisage des sites de maintenance et de remisage d'Issy-les-Moulineaux et de Colombes, avec le logiciel, la mise en service, la vérification de service régulier et la garantie de trois ans à compter de la réception définitive. Maximum : huit (8) dispositifs au total sur l'ensemble des lignes de tramway fer (T1, T2, T3a, T3b, T7, T8), le raccordement de cinq lignes supplémentaires au logiciel, la maintenance post-garantie des huit dispositifs et du logiciel jusqu'au terme du marché, la capacité de mesure des roues de 370 mm pour huit dispositifs (ligne optionnelle) et les prestations d'expertise technique, dans la limite des quantités maximales de l'article 17 du projet de marché. Les travaux préparatoires d'acheminement des réseaux et le génie civil sont réalisés par la RATP hors marché.

title: Ireland – Environmental training services – Provision of an Environmental Education Course
description: SKDP is seeking to deliver an environmental educational short course which is both informative and practical and which will be made available for participation to the public in the South Kerry area. This initiative is being developed in line with the 2023 – 2027 LEADER programme objectives which incorporates a number of thematic areas, one of which is ‘Sustainable Development and Climate Change Mitigation and Adaptation’. A sub-theme under this core theme is ‘Climate Change Capacity Building’. Climate change presents an ever-growing and existential challenge to Kerry’s rich and biodiverse ecological habitats and overall environmental health. This challenge is one which will affect not only our natural flora and fauna but also the wellness and health of our communities as well as their economic resilience as Kerry’s economy is heavily reliant on tourism. The Kerry Local Development Strategy which was developed through public participation to inform the core objectives of this current iteration of LEADER, found that an understanding of the science of climate change and in particular how Ireland and Southwest Ireland will be affected was a noticeable knowledge gap when engaging with the local communities. Priorities identified under the current LEADER programme include the provision of environmental educational training resources. To identify the specific areas of environmental education which groups would be most interested in, SKDP undertook a short public survey which was widely distributed to communities and community groups and remained open for 4.5 weeks. SKDP received 49 responses, with the outcome directing this RFT. SKDP are now seeking to enlist the expertise of an experienced environmental education/ training provider to develop and deliver an environmental education course. It is envisaged that this course will support the needs and priorities of these groups and their communities and support them to take meaningful local action for the environment. The objective of this RFT is to seek tenders from environmental education / training providers for the delivery of an environmental education course which will support communities to take meaningful local action to support biodiversity and to increase the resilience of habitats in their local areas. The course should be delivered as three modules. This is to enable participants, if they are unable to complete the full course, to complete one or two modules. The modules are as follows: 1. Seed Saving, Pollinators and Meadow Management 2. Tree Planting and Long-Term Management 3. Invasive Species Identification and Management The below are suggested inclusions for each module. SKDP invites tenderers to advise on the most appropriate and practicable approach to each module and are open to variations to the outline below.

title: Ireland – Hospital and related services – The Provision of a Treatment Pathway for Low Complexity Spinal Patients
description: The Contracting Authority intends to establish a framework agreement with suitably-qualified and experienced medical service providers to deliver end-to-end outpatient assessment, diagnostic and surgical treatment pathways for a cohort of approximately 1,200 patients. A low-complexity spine patient is defined as an individual with a straightforward, one or two level or localised spinal condition that requires standard surgical or medical management with minimal technical difficulty and lower physiological risk. Under the framework agreement, the successful tenderers will assume responsibility for patients from the first specialist outpatient assessment, through surgical intervention (if clinically indicated) until discharge. The successful framework operators shall assume clinical responsibility for the entire patient-care pathway, from initial specialist assessment through all clinically-indicated diagnostic, conservative, interventional and surgical management measures and associated specialist review. The service must be delivered by appropriately-qualified and accredited spinal surgical, medical, nursing, physiotherapy, radiology and allied health professionals, with access to anaesthetic / pain expertise where required.

title: National Trust-NI- Skernaghan Point - Woodland Creation
description: The National Trust is seeking a suitably qualified contractor to deliver woodland creation, hedgerow planting, fencing, and associated landscape improvement works at Skernaghan Point, Islandmagee, County Antrim. This project forms part of the National Trust's wider habitat restoration and nature recovery programme, aimed at enhancing biodiversity, improving habitat connectivity, and increasing climate resilience within this important coastal landscape. The successful contractor will be responsible for the provision of all labour, materials, plant, equipment, supervision, and management required to complete the works. Key elements of the contract include: • Native woodland creation within designated planting areas. • Establishment of native mixed-species hedgerows. • Supply and installation of stock-proof fencing. • Installation of gates, access infrastructure, and drinking troughs where specified. • Ground preparation, vegetation management, and ancillary establishment works. • Supply and installation of six timber dams (approximately 3m wide using larch rounds), with locations to be confirmed during the site visit. All works must be completed in accordance with National Trust requirements, project specifications, and industry best practice. Contractors are invited to submit a fixed-price quotation for the delivery of the works." title: J065-- Carestream Portable X-ray Service Base plus Four
description: SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE Carestream Portable X-Ray Maintenance Services Birmingham VA Medical Center Reference Number: 36C24727Q0062 NAICS: 811210 Electronic and Precision Equipment Repair and Maintenance PSC: J065 Maintenance, Repair, and Rebuilding of Equipment Medical, Dental, and Veterinary Equipment and Supplies PURPOSE The Department of Veterans Affairs, Network Contracting Office 7, is conducting market research to identify businesses authorized to provide maintenance and repair services through Carestream for existing equipment at Birmingham VA Medical Center. Responses are requested from interested businesses of all sizes, particularly SBA-certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSBs) and Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (VOSBs). Responses will assist the Government in determining the acquisition strategy, including potential small-business set-asides. PLACE OF PERFORMANCE Birmingham VA Medical Center 700 19th Street South Birmingham, AL 35233 ANTICIPATED PERIOD OF PERFORMANCE Period Dates Base Year December 12, 2026 December 11, 2027 Option Year 1 December 12, 2027 December 11, 2028 Option Year 2 December 12, 2028 December 11, 2029 Option Year 3 December 12, 2029 December 11, 2030 Option Year 4 December 12, 2030 December 11, 2031 DESCRIPTION OF REQUIREMENT The contemplated requirement includes maintenance coverage for: Two Carestream DRX Revolution mobile X-ray systems. Two Carestream LUX 35 mobile detectors. Services include preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, corrective repairs, parts, labor, travel, testing, calibration, applicable software and diagnostic support, and service documentation as described in the attached draft Statement of Work (SOW). The contemplated service arrangement requires Carestream to perform the maintenance and repair services. Respondents shall demonstrate their authorization to provide these services through Carestream and their ability to meet the draft SOW s coverage and response requirements. REQUESTED CAPABILITY INFORMATION Interested businesses shall provide: Company Information: Legal business name, address, point of contact, telephone number, email address, Unique Entity Identifier (UEI), and CAGE code, if assigned. Business Size and SBA Certification: Business size under NAICS 811210 and applicable socioeconomic status. Respondents claiming SDVOSB or VOSB status shall provide evidence of current active SBA certification. The Government will independently verify certification status. Carestream Service Authorization Letter: A current authorization letter on Carestream letterhead, issued by Carestream, confirming that the respondent is authorized to provide the required services through Carestream for the two DRX Revolution mobile X-ray systems and two LUX 35 detectors identified in the attached draft SOW. The letter shall identify the respondent s legal business name, the scope and duration of authorization, and confirm that Carestream will perform the required maintenance and repair services. Performance Approach: Describe how the respondent will coordinate service through Carestream, including service requests, scheduling, response times, service reports, and contract administration. Identify the work performed by the respondent and Carestream and address applicable limitations on subcontracting. Relevant Experience: Provide examples of similar OEM service arrangements, including equipment supported, scope, and period of performance. SOW Feedback: Identify requirements needing clarification and any barriers to performing the contemplated services. SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS Submit capability statements by 10/26/2026 at 12:00 PM Eastern Time to Jessica N. Cummings at Jessica.Cummings3@va.gov. Email subject: Sources Sought Response 36C24727Q0062 Carestream Maintenance Clearly identify proprietary information. Do not include patient information or other sensitive personal information. DISCLAIMER This notice is for market research only. It is not a solicitation, request for quotations, or commitment to award a contract. No acquisition strategy or set-aside determination has been finalized. The Government will not reimburse costs incurred in preparing responses. Any subsequent solicitation will contain the final requirements and submission instructions. ATTACHMENT Draft Statement of Work Carestream Portable X-Ray Maintenance Services

title: Borough of Etna, Pennsylvania, Local Protection Project (LPP) PL84-99 Rehabilitation
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Pittsburgh District, has a project that involves the rehabilitation of the Etna Federal Local Protection Project along West Little Pine Creek in the Borough of Etna and Shaler Township between station 24+00 and 26+90, Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The original channel and embankment sustained severe erosion and structural damage during storm events in April 2024. The work is to be completed within 120 calendar days after written Notice to Proceed (NTP). The Anticipated Construction Cost is between $200,000.00 and $450,000.00. The North American Industrial Classification Code (NAICS) is 237990 - Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction. The Small Business Size Standard is $45,000,000.00. Any resultant award will be for one (1) Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) Purchase Order. The anticipated award date is 13 November 2026. The basis of award will be of best value to the Government. Basis of Award is best value to the Government. Quotes will be evaluated in accordance with (IAW) RFO 12.203(a), price and past performance. The Government reserves the right to reject any quotes that are unrealistically low or exceed available funds for this requirement. title: DUAL ENROLLMENT PARTNERSHIP OPPORTUNITY ANNOUNCEMENT
description: The Department of War Education Activity (DoWEA) is seeking capability statements from eligible Institutions of Higher Education (IHEs) interested in establishing no-cost Memorandums of Understanding (MOUs) or Memorandums of Agreement (MOAs) to support dual or concurrent enrollment opportunities for DoWEA students worldwide. This announcement seeks institutional, academic, financial, technical, cybersecurity, privacy, and programmatic information from IHEs to assess their capability to participate in a dual enrollment partnership program pursuant to 10 U.S.C. � 2164c. This announcement is not a solicitation for proposals, request for quotations, request for offers, grant opportunity, or procurement action, and no contract award is contemplated. Responses will be used solely to evaluate institutional capabilities and determine whether DoWEA may pursue discussions regarding one or more no-cost MOUs or MOAs. Submission of a response does not guarantee selection, discussions, execution of an agreement, student participation, enrollment volumes, or future opportunities. Any resulting MOU or MOA will be non-procurement in nature and will not obligate the Government to expend funds, pay tuition or fees, reimburse participants, refer students, guarantee enrollments, or enter into any agreement. DoWEA may select one, multiple, or no respondents and reserves the right to discontinue consideration of any response at any time. All interested IHEs should review the full announcement for eligibility requirements, submission instructions, and response deadlines. For more information, please see attachment 27R0001_DualEnroll_OA_092426

Associated with the primary functions of the space will be necessary patient waiting areas, functional corridors, restroom facilities, conference space, record functions, and staff support areas. Existing buildings or build to suit in the delineated area will both be considered. The space must meet accessibility laws in accordance with 4 CFR 101-19.6, App A (Uniform Federal Accessibility Standards). Certified Halal items will be certified by a Halal Certification Agency. Quoters will include a letter of certification from the religious certification agency dated no more than 11 months from the date of the quote provided. All non-frozen and perishable foods must be delivered between 34 degrees F to 41 degrees F. The completed package should be returned no later than 12:00 p.m. Eastern Standard Time on October 26, 2026. Vendors shall submit signed and dated offers to Dilena Infante Contracting Officer, by email to DInfante@bop.gov by email ONLY. Fax, hand delivered, or mail-in quotes WILL NOT be accepted. Be sure to complete all information requested on page #1 of the quote sheet attachment. Information will be posted to the General Services Administration Federal Business Opportunities website: http://www.sam.gov. All future information about this acquisition, including amendments, cancellations, award letter and low quote(s) will also be distributed through this site. Interested parties are responsible for monitoring this site to ensure they have the most up-to-date information about this solicitation. The anticipated award date is on or about October 30, 2026. Questions "clarity only" will be answered by e-mail only (no phone calls please). Faith Based and Community Based Organizations have the right to submit quotes equally with other organizations for contracts for which they are eligible. All vendors must be completely registered in the System for Award Management, http://www.sam.gov prior to award, during performance, and through final payment of any contract resulting from this solicitation.

title: Germany – Planting and maintenance services of green areas – Planting of Seagrass for Ostwind 3 Offshore project between KP18.1-18.4
description: The main target for this operation is the planting of seagrass, either as a single plant or/and as a rope consisting plants. Employer is requesting the Bidder to submit a quotation for the execution of seagrass planting works. The designated location for the seagrass planting is at Ostwind 3 cable route between KP18.1 – 18.4, which is a 325m long and 7m wide (about 2300m²) corridor. Seagrass planting will require the following pre-requisites and follow-ups: A consolidated coarse sediment layer of approx. 20 - 30 cm thickness (engineered material), An execution plan, prepared early enough to achieve the permit in time A permit by authorities (STALU VP, WSA Ostsee), Sufficient plant material seagrass shoots (subject to availability, see details below) to be suitable for planting a harbor nearby (either Thiessow (8km), Freest (11km) or Lubmin (15km)) shall be used for hand-over of seagrass shoots/geotextile ropes with seagrass from Third Party supplier In case it is required the work area per operational day shall be first marked by rods/subsurface buoys attached to small ground weights prior to planting to allow for correct planting spatially and regarding shoot density/m². In case of non-fins-diving solutions it can be done different. shifting of work site day by day shall be enabled by installation of a remote-controlled sub-surface marker buoy with release system on last position of executed work, respectively work executed on previous days shall be inspected by means of underwater video (ROV or UW-drone) repeatedly General assumptions about the task: Total impact area to be restored will be ~2.300m² Work can be executed by divers in accordance with the requirements of DGUV Regel 101-023. Alternatively work can be executed by ROV, if the Contractor can proof the suitability of the technology by references Seagrass planting shall start (latest) on 1st of June 2027 and has to be completed by 31st of July 2027. Employer considers two alternative planting methods: (1) planting of single shoots (2) Installation of rotable fabric ropes with incorporated shoots Suitable ropes ready for installation will be provided by an assigned manufacturer. Single shoot planting planting is the preferred procedure, but rope installation shall be implemented in parallel too. If you are interested in participating in the described procedure, please contact us by e-mail (andre.forbrig@50hertz.com) and express your interest in participating. With the expression of interest, we need the following information from you in order to be able to add you to the project in Ariba: - Full name of the company: - Address of the company: - V.A.T. Number: - Tax Number: - Commercial register number: In addition, I need the contact details of the people who you should have access to the Ariba system: - Name - E-mail address - Phone number

title: Brand Name or Equal - WaterFurnace Model: UBH015R for B3631 & B3635 - Turnkey Replacement
description: The 502d Contracting Squadron (502CONS), on behalf of the 502d Civil Engineer Squadron (502CES), is conducting market research to determine: The availability and technical capability of industry sources (small and large businesses) to furnish and install 48 each 1.25-ton Dedicated Outside Air System (DOAS) Water-Source Heat Pumps (WSHP) which meet strict salient dimensions and environmental characteristics. The appropriate competitive acquisition strategy, including small business socio-economic set-aside determinations (RFO Part 19 Small Business - Rule of Two). Standard commercial practices, lead times, supply chain constraints, warranty terms, and pricing structures IAW RFO 10.002(b) Market Research. The contractor shall provide all personnel, management, equipment, tools, rigging, materials, and supervision necessary to execute the turnkey removal and replacement of 48 ceiling-suspended DOAS WSHP installed above exterior breezeway ceilings in B3631 and B3635 at JBSA Ft Sam Houston (FSH) San Antonio Military Medical Center (SAMMC) Dormitory Annex. This new requirement is projected to be a Firm-Fixed Priced (FFP) Purchase Order as a Commodity (Procurement) with incidental Services (Removal and Installation) buy. Key Salient Characteristics: Capacity: 1.25 Tons (15,000 BTUH nominal), airflow of 160 L/s (~340 CFM) at 50 Pa ESP. Configuration: Horizontal, ceiling-plenum suspended, right-hand return air arrangement. Access Dimension Constraint: Existing units are installed above metal panel breezeway ceilings accessible through structural door openings measuring approximately and replacement units must physically fit through these envelope openings without requiring structural building demolition. Refrigerant: Low-GWP refrigerant (e.g., R-454B or R-32). R-410A is strictly prohibited. Hydronic Pre-Heat Coil & Reheat: Integral 3.75 kW water-source pre-heat coil (3-way, 2-position control valve) and factory hot gas reheat (HGRH) / hot gas bypass (HGBP) for 100% outside air continuous dehumidification. Controls Integration: Complete integration into the installation's central Building Automation System (BAS via BACnet IP/MSTP).

title: Department of War Pharmacy Uniform Formulary Blanket Purchase Agreement / Uniform Formulary Additional Discount Program
description: The Department of War (DoW) is required by law (10 U.S.C. � 1074g) to establish an effective, efficient, integrated pharmacy benefits program for the Military Health System (MHS) which includes the purchase pharmaceutical agents. The law and implementing regulation (32 CFR Section 199.21) describe the process by which the DoW Pharmacy and Therapeutics (P&T) Committee will consider the relative clinical effectiveness and relative cost effectiveness of pharmaceutical agents in a therapeutic class in recommending the selection of agents for the DoW Uniform Formulary (UF) and, for cost sharing purposes, the classification of a pharmaceutical agent as generic, formulary, Basic Core Formulary (BCF), Extended Core Formulary (ECF), or non-formulary (NF). Prior to the scheduled P&T Committee meeting, a Request for Quotation (RFQ) for pharmaceutical agents within Drug Classes identified for placement on the UF has been issued to obtain quotes from industry. The Defense Health Agency may award Uniform Formulary Blanket Purchase Agreements (UF BPA) and the Uniform Formulary Additional Discount Program Agreements (UF ADP) based on the UF decision. This process is described in the attached RFQ. P&T COMMITTEE MEETING: The following November 2026 newly approved drugs will be reviewed: a. Adquey - Atopic - Subclass: Topical Agents b. title: 26Z1AY6_Replace Roofing_FCC Butner
description: This is a Sources Sought Notice. This notice is issued for market research purposes only. The awarded contractor is required to completely remove all existing roofing systems at FCC Butner�s Federal Prison Camp�including approximately 35,000 square feet of flat EPDM roofing and 27,000 square feet of pitched shingle roofing�and dispose of all materials before installing a new fully welded 80?mil TPO flat roof system with tapered EPS insulation and a 30?year Class A asphalt shingle system on pitched areas, ensuring all penetrations, transitions, drains, curbs, walls, skylights, HVAC units, and flashing are rebuilt to provide a watertight, manufacturer?approved installation.
